blocks: MF Number Pad, a Max MIDI Effect for Live 12

A Ableton/Max for Live MIDI Effect that collects the digits pressed on Launchpad/Custom/Available/3-MF-Number-Pad and, on Enter, sends the Microfreak the bank select and Program Change for that slot. It was made for Launchpad/Idea/Pick-MicroFreak-Presets-through-Live on 2026-11-26 Thu.

Its patcher is Launchpad/Idea/Pick-MicroFreak-Presets-through-Live/Asset/Device/MF-Number-Pad/maxpat. A copy named MF Number Pad.amxd sits in Live's User Library under Presets/MIDI Effects/Max MIDI Effect/.
